prompt: {"task":{"problem":"Design check (not a formal proof): verify a small UI/API design for the Arachne resource panel against loom's actual API surface, so that the claims below are either confirmed or corrected against the loom source. Questions: (1) Can the RHS resource panel show GitHub issues per topic without a Loom change, using issues.board + claimed_branch names from the topic subtree? (2) Are PRs already available per-session in the fleet snapshot (BranchSummaryView.github)? (3) Does the existing fleet SSE subscription see issue_added/issue_closed events so the panel can live-refresh? Statements to check: A. issues.board returns IssueView[] including repo_root, claimed_branch (branch name), github_issue, github_repo, github_state(null on board), status, title. B. BranchSummaryView.github is a PR snapshot maintained by loom's poll loop, present in sessions/summary/list output. C. issue_added/closed/reopened SSE events are recorded on the claiming branch's topic, and Arachne's fleet poller subscribes to session:<id> topics whose any event triggers a fleet re-snapshot, so new issues appear without new plumbing. D. An issue claimed by a branch name matches at most the sessions in the topic subtree sharing that branch name, so scoping issues to a topic = filtering board output by (repo_root of topic) ∪ (claimed_branch ∈ branch names of topic subtree). E. No loom-side change is needed for display; a loom-side change is needed only for durable per-topic binding of arbitrary issues/PRs (or Arachne can reuse its resources.rs manifest for that binding, with agent skills doing the attach).","assumptions":["Arachne speaks to Loom over its documented HTTP API; loom checkout at /Users/dlwh/src/loom is the API reference","Loom has no first-class topic→issue or topic→PR link; PR data arrives via BranchSummaryView.github in sessions/summary/list; issue data via POST /api/issues/board","Branch summary rows keyed by branch id; issue claims keyed by (repo_root, branch name)"],"knowledge":[],"strategy":null,"gate":null,"plan":null,"previousAttempt":null,"globalReview":null,"round":0},"perspective":"constructive proof","candidate":0}
